issues.description: The proposal leaves the timeline for Phase 3 entirely pending due to the Q3/Q4 contradiction. While the deployment date is correctly flagged as an open question, it would be helpful to provide an estimated duration for the deployment and testing phase itself (e.g., 2 weeks) so the client understands the total effort required once the start date is resolved.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the Phase 3 header to include an estimated duration, such as 'Phase 3: Pilot Deployment & Testing (Estimated 2 Weeks - Start Date Pending Alignment)'.

risks: The client exhibits severe internal misalignment between Operations/Finance (who want incremental fixes and a Q3 pilot) and Engineering/CTO (who wants a full platform replacement and a Q4 timeline). While the proposal navigates this masterfully by decoupling the workflow layer and explicitly calling out the discrepancies, there is a high risk that the project could stall before kickoff if the stakeholders cannot agree on the items listed in the Open Questions.
